documents.title: D&D 5e-Style RPR System
documents.description: Complete implementation of D&D 5e mechanics including Attack Bonus, Armor Class, Spell Save DC, attribute modifiers, 69 mutators for stat calculations, armor weight classes, and weapon properties. Demonstrates that complex D&D mechanics ARE possible in RPR.

documents.title: Comprehensive Combat & Profession System
documents.description: Production-quality RPR system from RpR dev featuring Action/Reaction combat, social skills, crafting professions (Fishing, Mining, Cooking, Blacksmithing), status effects, casino mechanics, teaching system, sparring with grappling, and 177+ abilities across Melee, Range, Magic, and Healing styles.

documents.title: Beatrix's RPR Learning Journey
documents.description: Real-world learning progression from Discord showing someone building an RPR system from scratch (Oct 2025 - Jan 2026). Includes problem-solving, formula evolution, common pitfalls (rune conditions don't work, status nameplate clutter, separator bugs), workarounds, and community solutions. Critical discoveries: use mutators not rune conditions, use perks not statuses for hidden tracking, configure separators properly.
